name: toolbox
title: Toolbox
description: For plumbers, electricians and other call-out trades: workwear navy and hi-vis yellow, van-side headings and phone numbers, job-sheet prices, and a hazard-striped call-now bar fixed to the bottom of every phone screen.

tokens.--font-display: headings, the business name and phone numbers (narrow and heavy, like lettering on a van)
tokens.--font-mono: prices, dates and code (typed figures, like a job sheet)
tokens.--text-s: small text: labels, opening hours, footer
tokens.--text-m: base body size, legible at arm's length
tokens.--text-l: card titles, customer quotes and the number on call buttons
tokens.--text-xl: section headings and the price on a service page
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of small capital labels
tokens.--color-panel: background of cards, the checklist, quotes and the call card
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings and the outline of a hovered card
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: labels, hours, footer, and the outline of quiet buttons
tokens.--color-accent: links in the text and the focus ring
tokens.--color-hivis: the hi-vis marking colour: the call bar and call button, the rule beside the business name, prices and quotes, the line under the current menu item
tokens.--color-on-hivis: text and outlines placed on the hi-vis colour
tokens.--color-stripe: the dark segments of the hazard stripe
tokens.--measure: widest a column of text may get
tokens.--page-width: widest the page may get (header, card grid, footer)
tokens.--aside-min: narrowest the call card may get when it stands beside the text on wide screens
tokens.--card-min: narrowest a service card may get before the grid drops a column
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a label and its value, between list items
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under headings, between menu links, inside the call bar
tokens.--space-3: standard gap: padding inside cards and panels, between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections and between the text and the call card
tokens.--space-5: space above the footer and the call card
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of cards and buttons
tokens.--border-strong: thickness of emphatic lines: header and footer rules, the call button outline
tokens.--focus-width: thickness of the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--tap-target: smallest height of anything meant to be tapped: buttons, menu links
tokens.--rule-hivis: thickness of the hi-vis rule beside the name, prices and quotes and under the current menu item
tokens.--stripe-height: height of the hazard stripe on the call bar and call card
tokens.--stripe-width: width of each diagonal band in the hazard stripe
